context: First inventory current chart rendering, result-file containment, tenant workspace roots, supported formats, artifact publication, and cleanup behavior. Choose an explicit response contract for inline content versus an opaque tenant-owned artifact handle/path; reject unsupported formats and traversal; never let caller-selected output_dir escape the server-owned chart root or leak another tenant. Preserve ASCII default compatibility. If file output is not justified for the supported MCP contract, document the intentional omission and close the item with evidence instead of adding a second publication model.
description: Successor of add-file-output-support-to-mcp-chart-generation-v2, whose scope omitted the existing schema test file identified by todo lint. Successor of add-file-output-support-to-mcp-chart-generation, promoted from deferral #523 of visualization-suggestions-and-render-orchestration. BenchBox MCP currently returns inline ASCII from generate_chart and accepts output_dir only as a reserved, unused argument. Define whether and how remote clients may request durable chart files, then implement the smallest safe contract if approved. This is separate from the stateless transport migration but affects remote MCP usability.
